knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Requests not tied to an authorised purpose are refused and recorded, whatever the agency's intent.
The handoff record separates what was agreed, done, unresolved and referred so the next service knows where things stand.
Only the authorised minimum is shared, on a confirmed legal basis, and health questions go to responsible people.

practicalCriteria: In a fictional case, the learner refuses one unauthorised request and writes the refusal record with the reason.
The learner writes a handoff record for a fictional case with the four sections separated.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: Personal documents or images are released without an authorised purpose.
Unverified health or personal details are recorded as fact.
